paper.title_en: GUEST: Gravitational Universe Exploration with Satellite Tracking. A passive satellite laser-ranging mission for the dark gravitational Universe
paper.abstract_en: GUEST is a space mission concept whose central objective is the detection of gravitational waves (GWs) in the microhertz band -- a physics-rich frequency window that no other present or planned detector can reach at a significant level. The concept is simple: two dense, passive spheres, covered with cube-corner retroreflectors, deployed in {highly eccentric} Earth orbits ($e \gtrsim 0.7$, period $P \gtrsim 33$ h), tracked continuously by the global network of satellite laser-ranging stations over a minimum observation time of 10 years, with an expected total duration of 30 years. The orbits themselves act as resonant detectors of the oscillating gravitational perturbations, with the microhertz sensitivity emerging from the selected orbital parameters. From the same data stream, GUEST delivers a programme of fundamental and applied science that cuts across particle physics, gravitational-wave astronomy, cosmology, astrophysics, and geodesy: the first coherent search for GWs from supermassive black-hole binaries in the $μ$Hz band, the exploration of primordial GW backgrounds in the unexplored energy-scale gap between pulsar-timing arrays and LISA, a dedicated probe of ultra-light dark matter in a parameter region untouched by any other experiment, a new way to search for ultra-light bosons, order-of-magnitude-improved tests of new gravitational interactions at astronomical ranges, and a step change in the absolute determination of $GM_\oplus$ that underpins the Global Geodetic Observing System and future navigation and Earth-observation missions. This white paper presents the motivation, scientific reach, and mission concept of GUEST.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文提出GUEST空间任务概念，旨在微赫兹频段探测引力波，涵盖脉冲星计时阵列、超轻暗物质、引力基础检验等，与PTA和高频引力波相关，创新性强且科学意义重大。
decision.title_zh: GUEST：利用卫星跟踪探索引力宇宙。一项用于暗引力宇宙的被动卫星激光测距任务
decision.abstract_zh: GUEST是一个空间任务概念，其核心目标是在微赫兹频段探测引力波（GW）——这是一个物理丰富的频率窗口，其他现有或计划中的探测器无法达到显著水平。该概念简单：两个密集的被动球体，覆盖着立方角后向反射器，部署在高度椭圆的近地轨道（$e \gtrsim 0.7$，周期$P \gtrsim 33$小时），由全球卫星激光测距站网络连续跟踪，最低观测时间为10年，预期总持续时间为30年。轨道本身作为振荡引力扰动的共振探测器，微赫兹灵敏度来自所选的轨道参数。从相同的数据流中，GUEST提供了一项跨粒子物理学、引力波天文学、宇宙学、天体物理学和大地测量学的基础和应用科学计划：首次在$μ$Hz频段对超大质量黑洞双星的GW进行连贯搜索，在脉冲星计时阵列和LISA之间未探索的能量尺度间隙中探索原始GW背景，在任何其他实验未触及的参数区域中专用探测超轻暗物质，寻找超轻玻色子的新方法，在天文尺度上对新的引力相互作用进行数量级改进的测试，以及支撑全球大地测量观测系统以及未来导航和地球观测任务的$GM_\oplus$绝对确定的阶跃变化。这本白皮书介绍了GUEST的动机、科学价值和任务概念。
